scientific_integrity: Fully reproducible RREF census over all rank-r binary coefficient subspaces; rank-10 evaluation injectivity and Gaussian subspace totals checked; 2015 existing boundary weights correctly credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite binary (2 by 3 matrix) affine Grassmann code only; no result for larger matrices, other fields or all family members. title: Complete generalized Hamming weights of the binary \(2\times3\) affine Grassmann code
